messages:
priya: FYI saw embedding-quality drift on eu-dedicated canary after rolling model v3.10.0 -> baseline eval on our customer prompt set shows ~4.6% drop in nearest-neighbor recall. not huge but above our alert threshold.

jamal: which prompt set and how many samples?

priya: narrow-custset-encodes (prod subset, ~1.2k queries). p50 unchanged, p95 worse. latency and cost normal.

lisa: deploy-bot triggered an autoprobe earlier?

deploy-bot: autoprobe: metric "embed_recall_delta" = 0.046 > threshold 0.04. action suggested: PAUSE rollout + partial pin for eu region. details: reason=quality-drift, samples=1250, confidence=0.87.

matt: confidence under 0.9 — noisy but actionable. I'm worried about false positives from this smaller cust set. Can we replicate on staging with the same seeds?

priya: replicated quick A/B on staging, delta 0.043 with same seed. seems consistent.

jamal: ops perspective: if we pause we should either do a manual rollback to 3.9.5 or pin traffic to 3.9.5 for eu-dedicated while we investigate. Which is lower risk?

lisa: pin is lower blast radius — leaves hosted and dedicated in other regions unaffected. we can do a targeted pin + customer comms.

opsbot: recommended command to pin:

```
redwoodctl rollout pin --target-region eu --service embeddings --model redwood-3.9.5 --duration 2h --reason "canary embed regression"
```

matt: 👍 runbook? who executes and who owns customer messages?

priya: ops runs the pin. product drafts the release-note blurb and support prepares the customer template. legal looped in for wording for paying customers.

sarah (legal): quick read: keep wording factual, no admit of long-term data loss. suggest: "we detected a model quality regression in a limited EU canary and have pinned EU inference to the prior validated model while we investigate."

jamal: timeline: ops can pin in 15m, prob-monitor 30m, post mortem TBD. who notifies customers?

lisa: support to send targeted note to EU Dedicated customers with instances in the affected pool. use internal ticket tag: #eu-embed-pin. I'll coordinate with account owners.

matt: checklist before pin: 1) confirm deploy-bot autoprobe 2) staging replicate 3) ops ready 4) support & legal message draft.

priya: all done except ops step. ops, can you execute and paste the command output here when done?

opsbot: executing pin in 10s...

opsbot: SUCCESS: rollout pin applied. pinned redwood-3.9.5 -> eu-dedicated (pool ids: eu-ded-01, eu-ded-02). ticket=RD-4872.

matt: monitoring dashboards up: please watch these graphs: embed_recall_delta, customer_errors, p95-latency. I'll keep 30m watch.

priya: support & product: draft messages ready?

lisa: customer template draft: "We detected a minor model-quality regression in EU and have temporarily pinned EU inference to a prior validated model (v3.9.5) while our engineers investigate. This change is non-disruptive but may affect subtle embedding results. We'll follow up with findings and timeline."

sarah (legal): approved.

matt: ops, after 30m if metrics stable, keep pin and open a rollback-investigation ticket. If metrics worsen, escalate to auto-rollback runbook.

opsbot: noted. schedule: 30m watch, automated alert if embed_recall_delta > 0.04 persists or customer error rate > 0.5%.

priya: created follow-up ticket: INF-9123 (investigate model change causing recall drop). assigning to eng-ml.

jamal: thanks team. After investigation, we'll decide on full rollback vs model-fix + gradual re-roll. For now, pin + comms is the right balance. :thumbsup:

lisa: will send customer notifications now and update the support internal playbook.

matt: closing the loop here — keep updates in the ticket and add any relevant logs/benchmarks.

priya: thanks, marking thread resolved for deploy coordination.
